text: A farm has chickens and cows. There are 30 heads and 74 legs in total. How many cows are there?
Adult tickets cost $12 and child tickets cost $5. A theater sold 150 tickets for a total of $1,240. How many adult tickets were sold?
Maria is 4 times as old as her son. In 20 years she will be twice as old as him. How old is Maria now?
A jar holds only nickels and dimes, 40 coins in all. Their total value is 290 cents. How many dimes are in the jar?
The sum of a larger number and a smaller number is 56, and their difference is 14. What is the larger number?
A rectangle's length is 3 meters more than its width, and its perimeter is 46 meters. What is the width?
Pens cost $2 each and notebooks cost $3 each. Sam spent $31 on 13 items. How many notebooks did Sam buy?
Ann, Ben and Cal have 70 marbles together. Ben has 10 more than Ann, and Cal has twice as many as Ann. How many marbles does Cal have?

A bakery makes cakes and pies. Each cake needs 2 hours of oven time and each pie needs 1 hour; there are 40 oven hours available. Each cake and each pie needs 1 kg of flour, and there are 30 kg of flour. Profit is $8 per cake and $5 per pie. What is the maximum profit?

A feed mix uses oats and beans. Each unit of oats gives 3 grams of protein and each unit of beans gives 2 grams. The mix needs at least 18 grams of protein and at least 8 units in total. Oats cost $4 per unit and beans cost $3 per unit. What is the minimum cost?
A plumber charges a $40 call-out fee plus $25 per hour. A job cost $140. How many hours did the job take?
Joe has 3 more apples than twice the number Kim has. Together they have 27 apples. How many apples does Joe have?
Half of Lena's savings plus 7 dollars is 19 dollars. How much has Lena saved?
A van can carry at most 1,200 kg. Each crate weighs 45 kg and the driver weighs 80 kg. What is the largest number of crates the van can carry?
A jacket costs $80 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
note: Known v0 gap: needs derived coefficient 1 - 20% = 0.8
